notes.trinkets: There are a great number of Trinkets available for Outlaw, and we will always want to play a combination of two powerful passive trinkets like Zul'jin's Guillotine Technique and Voracious Heart of Ula'tek . Outlaw has no meaningful burst cooldowns, so playing a on-use trinket is not that powerful for us, but the Heart of Ula'tek is simply too strong.
